page.notes: Section XXXVI opens with a woodcut initial "A" (joined to "N verò" as printed: the text reads "Nverò" with initial A); the first word is printed "ANte" in the scan as "N verò", transcribed as printed: "N verò Gregorium". Marginal notes (right margin, beside the lines of XXXVI): "Phocæ Imperatoris decretum, quo Ecclesia Romana caput omnium Ecclesiarum declaratur, à Bonifacio III. confirmatum." Greek catchword "Nipφ" and signature "F" are at the foot. Original text of the first paragraph is printed as "N verò Gregorium"; the drop cap is shown as a woodcut and is not reproduced.
